description: This file contains utility functions for generating OpenAPI specifications in FastAPI, including handling security definitions, parameters, request bodies, responses, and path schemas. It also defines some common validation error schemas.

methods.name: get_openapi_security_definitions
methods.description: Generates security definitions and security requirements for an OpenAPI operation based on dependencies.

methods.name: get_openapi_operation_parameters
methods.description: Creates a list of OpenAPI parameter objects from route dependencies and parameters.

methods.name: get_openapi_operation_request_body
methods.description: Constructs the OpenAPI requestBody object from a route's body field.

methods.name: generate_operation_id
methods.description: Generates a unique operationId for an API route, deprecated in favor of other mechanisms.

methods.name: generate_operation_summary
methods.description: Creates a summary string for an API operation based on route info.

methods.name: get_openapi_operation_metadata
methods.description: Builds the metadata object for an OpenAPI operation, including tags, summary, description, operationId, and deprecation status.

methods.name: get_openapi_path
methods.description: Generates the OpenAPI path item object for a given route, including responses, parameters, request body, and callbacks.

methods.name: get_fields_from_routes
methods.description: Extracts all relevant ModelFields from a list of routes for schema generation.

methods.name: get_openapi
methods.description: Main function to generate the complete OpenAPI specification document for given routes and webhooks.
